summary: The design’s main risks are at existing mutable-source, authorization, parameter-binding, cache, and MCP identity seams. The current RLS implementation mutates shared sources and inlines values, while the existing data-plane guard is intentionally fail-open; both require explicit semantic-layer isolation before implementation.

suggestions.title: Add a strict semantic authorization boundary
suggestions.rationale: DataPlanePolicyGuard and AuthorizingDataSource fail open when PermissionContext is absent or navigator-auth is unavailable. Governed semantic requests must instead reject before catalog exposure, compilation output, cache hits, saved queries, or execution.

suggestions.title: Make RLS injection immutable and request-scoped
suggestions.rationale: AuthorizingDataSource mutates self._inner.sql and permanent filters. DatasetManager wraps sources at registration, and the HTTP clone shares entry.source objects between user managers. Repeated or concurrent requests can accumulate predicates or leak one subject’s restrictions to another.

suggestions.title: Replace string RLS templates with typed predicates and driver adapters
suggestions.rationale: RlsRule accepts arbitrary SQL text, RlsPredicate stores string lists, and the current injector explicitly inlines values because SQLQuerySource uses format-based substitution. This conflicts with typed parameter requirements and the different parameter conventions of Postgres, BigQuery, and DuckDB. Parse policy predicates at load time and render through a driver-specific bind adapter.

suggestions.title: Specify fail-closed AST push-down semantics
suggestions.rationale: The existing injector wraps the completed query, which applies predicates after aggregation. The replacement must rewrite each matching base exp.Table while preserving aliases, CTEs, joins, and column visibility; unresolved lineage, table functions, or unsupported constructs should reject rather than fall back to wrapping.

suggestions.title: Disable subject-independent caches for governed results
suggestions.rationale: DataSource documents cache keys as shared across agents, and QuerySlugSource has built-in caching. PermissionContext metadata contains RLS inputs such as groups and programs but is excluded from UserSession hashing. Governed result caching must be disabled, or keyed by a complete subject/policy/model digest; only pre-governance compiler output should be reusable.

suggestions.title: Authorize model resources before compilation
suggestions.rationale: Semantic model files already declare physical connections and tables, while DataPlanePolicyGuard currently authorizes after a source has been resolved. Use a two-phase check: authorize the model’s declared resources before compiling or returning SQL, then extract compiled tables and reject any resource not in the authorized manifest.

suggestions.title: Keep credentials out of SemanticQuery
suggestions.rationale: DatabaseQueryToolkit methods accept per-call credentials, and get_source returns cached source instances. A semantic query must carry only a server-resolved connection name; reject credential-like fields and resolve credentials internally from trusted configuration before PBAC and execution.

suggestions.title: Create a semantic audit ledger contract
suggestions.rationale: AuditLedgerEntry is fixed to credential-invocation fields, and AuditLedger swallows durable-storage failures while retaining only an in-memory record. It cannot directly satisfy signed compiled SQL, policy context, engine, outcome, and execution metadata. Define a versioned semantic entry and decide whether governed results are denied when durable audit persistence fails.

suggestions.title: Define authenticated identity transport for mcp-local
suggestions.rationale: mcp-local loads a toolkit from static YAML and instantiates it without a PermissionContext or authentication middleware. A governed toolkit exposed there will either deny every request or run all requests under one unsafe static identity. Add a signed host-provided identity envelope or expose only compile-only/non-governed tools.

suggestions.title: Add adversarial positive-guard and lineage fixtures
suggestions.rationale: QueryValidator is primarily a negative DDL/DML and single-statement check; it does not establish table, column, function, masking, or lineage allowlists. Tests should cover unknown identifiers, SELECT *, aliases, CTEs, nested queries, quoted names, windows, joins, derived sensitive columns, multi-statements, and forced/capped limits across all v1 dialects.

suggestions.title: Make compiler parity and reentrancy release gates
suggestions.rationale: The design relies on two compilers and an undocumented sidemantic thread-safety property. Require concurrent compile tests through asyncio.to_thread, normalized-AST parity tests between sidemantic and native engines, and executable DuckDB fixtures; snapshot dialect-specific SQL for Postgres and BigQuery.

suggestions.title: Make free SQL and dataset hand-off later opt-in features
suggestions.rationale: The existing free-SQL validator is not a positive semantic guard, and current DatasetManager hand-off shares source objects even when DataFrames are copied. Ship governed metric queries first; expose run_sql and save_result_as_dataset only after subject-scoped source cloning, masking, cache isolation, and lineage tests pass.
